immediateKnownGaps: Legacy EditSnake exists alongside SnakeEdit and must be reference-audited before retirement.
The /learn route currently redirects to /challenge rather than providing the required Learning Hub.
Firestore rules currently mix creator claims, users.role and users.isTester; capability consolidation is required.
Client Firestore writes to supporterWall are creator-only; Titan recognition must remain backend-callable and consent-driven.
Notification implementation could not be confirmed through current code search and needs a dedicated source audit.
BreedingPlanner route exists but requires functional lifecycle verification against the specification.
